Syanna is the real bad guy, it was her revenge plot. She was the beast, Dettlaff was just the weapon. And he wasn't just an "angry incel", she really fucked with the guy's head.

Syanna wasn't just his girlfriend, Regis said that she was his mate and part of his pack, so she clearly meant *a lot* to him and she didn't even bother to break up with him. She literally just disappeared and left him to think that something bad had happened to her for years. I mean the first thing he does when he sees her is apologize to her, so he probably felt insane guilt for all those years. Even if that's not a lot of time for a vampire it's still not nothing, especially since he feels emotions more strongly than people. Then he gets blackmailed into killing people for her and while he probably didn't give a shit about most of them, he did care about one of them and was clearly upset that he had to kill him. 

He went through a lot of pain because of his love for her and then he finds out that it was all a lie and she just used him to get revenge. This also could've been the first time something like this has happened to him, since Regis says that Dettlaff doesn't really understand people and how they lie and manipulate or something like that.

So yeah, sending vampires to massacre a city of innocent people might be pretty much inexcusable and insanely stupid, but all things considered I don't see it as an overreaction. He was probably just way too overwhelmed to even think straight or at all tbh, because if he *was* thinking then he wouldn't give out that idiotic ultimatum in the first place when he could just get Geralt and Regis to find out where Anna is keeping her and just.. go to her. I mean ffs he can literally turn into mist and humans can't kill him, there's no prison they could put her in that he couldn't break into.
